title: Doberman Dog Tags for Scary-Looking Softies | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny doberman dog tags, laser engraved in Lehi, Utah. Sayings for the dog that looks scary and fears lizards. Name and number on the back. From $12.
blurb: Engraved tags for a dog that looks like private security and acts like a 90-pound lap dog. A funny tag tells strangers the truth before they cross the street.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Built for a dog that leans on everyone
tough.html:
A doberman's tag takes a beating from sprints, roughhousing and the constant leaning on human legs. Short coats mean the tag is always out in the open, too.

Our text is laser-cut into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing to rub off.

Looks tough. Tag is tougher.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Dobermans and bulldogs both get judged by their looks. The doberman lines come from owners tired of people crossing the street.

sayings.h2: 8 doberman sayings for the softest bodyguard
sayings.lead: Front of the tag. About the tough look and the soft heart. Name and number on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will running and roughhousing wear off the engraving?
items.a: No. The text is laser engraved into the metal, so scuffs don't erase it.

items.q: Can I put my doberman's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes. Saying on the front, name and phone number on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for dobermans?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the tough look and the lap-dog reality. Each fits the tag as written.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
